jupas.shortDescription: an class="before_label">Short Description The Mechanical and Automation Engineering (MAE) Programme of CUHK aims at offering solid education and cutting-edge research opportunities around two aspects of engineering: (1) the proper physical interaction of engineering systems with the physical world through force, heat, and energy ("Mechanical"); and (2) the self-operability of the systems demanding minimum intervention from humans ("Automation"). MAE seeks to design and control such interaction based upon fundamental knowledge on rigid body mechanics, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and conservation of mass and energy. It is also desired that engineering systems do not just do what is instructed but exhibit certain degree of autonomy in their operations, based upon knowledge on mechatronics, robotics and control.

cuhkAdmission.introduction: Explore the Path from Hand-made to Automation Combining hands-on discovery and analysis allows the students to develop creative solutions to life and engineering problems after completing the Mechanical and Automation Engineering (MAEGN) programme at CUHK. The MAEGN programme emphasizes the impact of modern automation technologies on current and future developments in the field of mechanical engineering, allowing students to establish a solid foundation in the core principles of mechanical and automation engineering. The programme also stresses a balanced curriculum in both basic theory and hands-on practice, covering subject areas as mechanics and materials, thermodynamics, mechanical design, manufacturing processes, mechatronics and robotics. Exploring mechanics and materials gives the students a deep understanding of how objects and materials behave under different forces and loads. Studying thermodynamics enables the students to grasp the principles of energy transfer, and studying mechanical design empowers them to create innovative solutions. Furthermore, the students delve into the interdisciplinary fields of robotics and automation systems, in which they learn about the design and operation of intelligent machines, automated systems and robotics. The programme also offers a range of other learning opportunities to enhance the educational journey of the students, such as exchanges, internships, work-study programmes, research projects and competitions.

cuhkAdmission.craftYourPath: The curriculum covers fundamental knowledge in the areas of mechanical and automation engineering, including mechanics and materials, thermodynamics, control, manufacturing and electronics. Students can pursue more in-depth knowledge in the subjects of their choice, such as computer-aided design and graphics, robotics, mechatronics, intelligent systems, engineering optimization and MEMS. Students may choose to specialize in one of the following three streams: Design and Manufacturing Mechatronics Robotics and Automation Dual Degree Option Students can pursue the Mechanical and Automation Engineering-Integrated Business Administration double-degree programme.

curriculum.title: Curriculum
content: The MAEGN programme offers a balanced curriculum in both basic theory and hands-on practice, covering core areas: mechanics and materials, thermodynamics, mechanical design, manufacturing processes, mechatronics and robotics.

Students explore mechanics and materials to understand how objects behave under forces and loads; study thermodynamics to grasp energy transfer principles; and learn mechanical design to create innovative solutions.
The programme also delves into interdisciplinary fields of robotics and automation systems, covering design and operation of intelligent machines, automated systems and robotics.
Students may choose to specialize in one of three streams: Design and Manufacturing, Mechatronics, or Robotics and Automation.
A Dual Degree Option is available: Mechanical and Automation Engineering – Integrated Business Administration double-degree programme.
Additional learning opportunities include exchanges, internships, work-study programmes, research projects and competitions.

career.title: Career Prospects
content: MAEGN graduates possess professional skills to pursue a wide range of job opportunities across industries.
Graduates have secured roles as: mechanical engineers, production engineers, control engineers, design engineers, process engineers, maintenance engineers, systems managers, and more.

Employers include: CLP Holdings Limited, The Hongkong Electric Company, ATAL Engineering Limited, Hong Kong Aircraft Engineering Company Limited, Swire Properties Limited, Schneider Electric (Hong Kong) Limited, Hong Kong Aero Engine Services Limited, MTR Corporation Limited, and the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department.

campus.title: Campus Life
content: CUHK's Shatin campus offers a vibrant learning environment with state-of-the-art facilities, including the T Stone Robotics Institute and engineering labs.
Students benefit from the unique college system, with nine colleges providing pastoral care, cultural activities, and residential life.
The programme supports exchanges, internships, and work-study programmes to enrich the student experience.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness
content: In 2025, JS4408 received 339 Band A applications and made 43 offers, yielding a Band A offer rate of approximately 12.7%.
Band A apps per offer: ~7.9, indicating strong competition.
Median admission score: 31.5 (Best 5); LQ: 30.5.
The programme requires an interview for selected applicants, adding an extra layer of selection.

alumni.title: Alumni & Faculty Excellence
content: Notable alumni include:
Wong Kam-fai (黃錦輝) – Professor at CUHK, expert in natural language processing and information retrieval; former Associate Dean of Engineering.
Lau Kin-wah (劉建華) – CEO of a major Hong Kong engineering firm; recognized for contributions to automation in manufacturing.
Chan Chi-hou (陳志豪) – Senior engineer at MTR Corporation, leading automation projects for railway systems.

Faculty excellence: Department faculty have received multiple Best Paper Awards in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering; professors lead the CUHK T Stone Robotics Institute; faculty hold editorial roles in top journals such as IEEE/ASME Transactions on Mechatronics.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS4408 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Target Score: 31.5+ (Best 5)**
- The median is 31.5; aim for at least 31 to be competitive. LQ is 30.5, so 31+ gives a solid chance.
**2. Prioritize Weighted Subjects**
- Biology, Chemistry, DAT, ICT are multiplied by 1.25. If you take any of these, focus on achieving high grades to boost your score.
**3. Excel in Mathematics and M1/M2**
- The median admit has Math 5* and M1/M2 4. Strong math performance is critical.
**4. Secure English and Chinese at 4**
- Median admits have Level 4 in both languages. Don't neglect these; they count in Best 5.
**5. Ace the Interview**
- Interview is required for selected applicants. Prepare to discuss your interest in mechanical/automation engineering, hands-on projects, and problem-solving skills.
**6. Build a Strong Portfolio**
- Participate in robotics competitions, engineering projects, or internships. Highlight these in your application and interview.
**7. Apply Band A**
- All 43 offers went to Band A applicants. Place JS4408 in Band A to maximize your chance.
**8. Understand the Curriculum**
- Familiarize yourself with the three streams (Design & Manufacturing, Mechatronics, Robotics & Automation) and the dual degree option. Mention your preferred stream in the interview.
**9. Leverage CUHK Resources**
- Mention the T Stone Robotics Institute, college system, and exchange programmes in your personal statement or interview to show you've researched the programme.

curriculum.title: 課程結構
content: 機械與自動化工程學課程提供理論與實踐並重的均衡課程，涵蓋核心領域：力學與材料、熱力學、機械設計、製造過程、機電一體化及機器人學。
學生探索力學與材料，了解物體在力與負載下的行為；學習熱力學掌握能量傳遞原理；並通過機械設計創造創新解決方案。
課程亦深入機器人學與自動化系統的跨學科領域，涵蓋智能機器、自動化系統及機器人的設計與操作。
學生可選擇以下三個分流之一專攻：設計與製造、機電一體化、機器人學與自動化。
設有雙學位選項：機械與自動化工程 – 工商管理綜合課程雙學位。
其他學習機會包括交流、實習、工讀計劃、研究項目及比賽。

career.title: 就業前景
content: 畢業生具備專業技能，可在各行各業追求廣泛就業機會。
畢業生曾任職位包括：機械工程師、生產工程師、控制工程師、設計工程師、工藝工程師、維修工程師、系統經理等。
僱主包括：中電集團、香港電燈有限公司、安樂工程集團、香港飛機工程有限公司、太古地產有限公司、施耐德電氣（香港）有限公司、香港航空發動機維修服務有限公司、香港鐵路有限公司及機電工程署。

campus.title: 校園生活
content: 香港中文大學沙田校園提供充滿活力的學習環境，配備先進設施，包括T Stone機器人學研究所及工程實驗室。
學生受益於獨特的書院制度，九所書院提供關顧、文化活動及住宿生活。
課程支持交流、實習及工讀計劃，豐富學生體驗。

tips.title: Ace Sir的JS4408策略 — 9個實用貼士
content: - 中位數為31.5；目標至少31分以增加競爭力。下四分位數為30.5，31分以上機會較大。
**2. 優先處理加權科目**
- 生物、化學、設計與應用科技、資訊及通訊科技乘以1.25。如修讀這些科目，務必爭取高分以提升總分。
**3. 數學及M1/M2表現突出**
- 中位數錄取者數學5*、M1/M2 4。數學成績至關重要。
**4. 中英文達4級**
- 中位數錄取者中英文均為4級。切勿忽視；它們計入最佳5科。
**5. 面試表現出色**
- 需要面試（選定申請人）。準備討論你對機械/自動化工程的興趣、動手項目及解決問題的能力。
**6. 建立豐富履歷**
- 參加機器人比賽、工程項目或實習。在申請及面試中突出這些經歷。
**7. 將課程放在Band A**
- 所有43個錄取均來自Band A申請人。將JS4408放在Band A以最大化機會。
**8. 了解課程內容**
- 熟悉三個分流（設計與製造、機電一體化、機器人學與自動化）及雙學位選項。在面試中提及你偏好的分流。
**9. 善用中大資源**
- 在個人陳述或面試中提及T Stone機器人學研究所、書院制度及交流計劃，顯示你已深入了解課程。
